title: Srijan 2025 — Annual Cultural Extravaganza
description: ISM's largest cultural festival returns with 4 days of music, dance, drama, and art. Headlined by national artists, Srijan 2025 draws 10,000+ students from across India. Compete in 30+ events or just soak in the vibe — this is the cultural heartbeat of campus.

title: Concetto 2025 — Technical Symposium
description: IIT ISM's flagship technical festival — 48 hours of hackathons, robotics wars, drone racing, paper presentations, and expert talks from industry leaders at Google, ISRO, and L&T. 500+ teams from 120 colleges compete for ₹5L in prizes.

title: KHANAN — Mining & Earth Sciences Fest
description: Exclusively for mining, petroleum, and applied geology students — KHANAN brings together core-branch companies, alumni from ONGC, Coal India, and Vedanta for talks, technical quizzes, and plant visit opportunities. The most impactful fest for placements.

title: Parakram — Inter-Hostel Sports Championship
description: 12 hostels. 18 sports. 1 champion. Parakram is ISM's most fiercely contested annual sports event — from cricket to swimming to chess. Every point matters. Every game is a battle. Which hostel will lift the trophy this year?

title: HackFest ISM — 36-Hour Hackathon
description: Build anything in 36 hours. HackFest ISM brings together coders, designers, and product thinkers to solve real problems in Ed-Tech, FinTech, and Smart Mining. Mentors from top startups, cloud credits, and ₹2L in prizes. 500 participants, 100+ teams.
venue: CS Department & Main Atrium, IIT ISM

title: CP Masterclass — Dynamic Programming Deep Dive
description: Coding Club ISM presents a 3-hour intensive session on Dynamic Programming with problems from Codeforces Div 1. Led by 4 red-rated competitive programmers from ISM. Walk in as a beginner, walk out solving hard DP problems.

title: Data Science Bootcamp — ML for Real Problems
description: DSTC presents a 2-day bootcamp on applied machine learning — from data cleaning to model deployment. Work on real datasets: earthquake prediction, energy consumption, and ore grade estimation. Certificates provided. Limited to 60 seats.

title: IoT Hackathon — Smart Campus Challenge
description: IoT Club ISM challenges you to build a working smart-campus prototype in 24 hours using Arduino, Raspberry Pi, and sensors provided on-site. Best project gets funded by the Institute Innovation Council. Win hardware kits, IoT certifications, and startup mentorship.
venue: Workshop Shed, Mechanical Block, IIT ISM

title: Manthan — Open Mic & Acoustic Night
description: Manthan Music Club hosts its monthly open mic under the stars. Bring your guitar, your poetry, or just your voice. No judgement. No competition. Just music, chai, and the best nights at ISM. Performers and listeners both welcome.
venue: Open Air Theatre, IIT ISM Dhanbad

title: Naatak — Annual Drama Production by Abhay
description: Abhay Dramatics presents their annual full-length play — a 90-minute original production written, directed, and performed entirely by ISM students. This year's theme: 'The Weight of a Degree'. Expect tears, laughs, and a standing ovation.

title: Vox Populi — Annual Debate Championship
description: Literary Club ISM's flagship debate tournament. 60 teams across 4 formats: British Parliamentary, Asian Parliamentary, MUN, and Elocution. Open to all UG and PG students. Grand prize: ₹15,000 + certificate. Registration deadline: 3 days before event.

title: E-Summit ISM — Entrepreneurship & Innovation Summit
description: Entrepreneurship Cell ISM brings together 20+ startup founders, VC investors, and IIT alumni for a full day of talks, panels, and the flagship startup pitching competition. Network, learn, pitch, and win up to ₹1L in seed funding.

title: Mining Conclave — Industry Expert Masterclass
description: Senior engineers from Coal India, ONGC, and Hindalco speak on current challenges in sustainable mining, automation, and career paths in the core sector. Q&A session + networking dinner. This is the kind of event that changes placements.
venue: Mining Dept Seminar Room, IIT ISM

title: Lens & Light — Campus Photography Exhibition
description: Photography Club ISM presents 80+ prints shot entirely on campus — from foggy winter mornings at the clock tower to late-night study sessions in the hostel corridors. Submit your best 3 shots by the deadline. Public exhibition open to all.
venue: Gallery Space, Students' Activity Centre, ISM

title: Roborace — Line Follower & Maze Solver Championship
description: Robotics Club ISM's most popular event. Build a bot that navigates a maze faster than everyone else's. Hardware workshop 2 days before the competition. Prizes for fastest time, most elegant design, and best crash of the day.

title: Stock Market Simulation — Bull vs Bear
description: Finance Club ISM simulates a live 4-hour stock market with real-time events, shocks, and insider leaks. Trade, strategise, and emerge with the highest portfolio value. Past winners have gone on to trading desks at HDFC Securities and Zerodha.
venue: Computer Lab A, IIT ISM Dhanbad

title: Gyaan — All-India Inter-IIT Quiz
description: Quiz Club ISM hosts the most gruelling quiz on campus — science, current affairs, sports, music, pop culture. 10 rounds. 4-member teams. 90-minute knockout format. Participation from 15+ IITs, ISM, NITs. Champion team takes ₹20,000 and eternal bragging rights.

title: Nritya — Annual Classical & Contemporary Dance Show
description: Dance Club ISM's annual production brings together Bharatanatyam, Kathak, hip-hop, and contemporary forms in a single 2-hour showcase. 80 performers, 10 choreographies, 1 unforgettable evening. Book early — this sells out every year.

title: NSS Blood Donation Drive — Save a Life
description: NSS IIT ISM partners with Patliputra Blood Bank for the semester's largest blood donation drive. Voluntary participation. Juice, snacks, and donor certificates provided. Every unit donated can save up to 3 lives. Last drive collected 312 units.
venue: Students' Activity Centre Lawn, IIT ISM

title: Stargazing Night — Astronomy Club ISM
description: Escape the hostel and spend a night under the Milky Way. Astronomy Club ISM sets up 8 telescopes on the football ground. Expert guide-through of Jupiter's moons, the Orion Nebula, and Saturn's rings. Chai and stargazing — the best combo.
